summary: Delixy Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice. The filing reports that from March 11 to April 22, 2026, the company's Class A ordinary shares traded below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. Nasdaq granted a 180-day compliance period ending October 20, 2026, during which the company can regain compliance if the closing bid price stays at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. If not, it may seek a second compliance period and consider a reverse stock split. This is a routine exchange notification, not a special situation. No deal terms are stated.
